summary: Frontend-only verification of WalletPage.jsx bug fix (yellow 'Money You Can Spend' banner + 'My Garden' XP jar removal). All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. The old totals banner (data-testid=total-balance) is fully removed from DOM; jar-investing card is removed from money-jars-grid for both Grade 1 (My Garden) and Grade 4 (Stocks). Top of /wallet correctly renders exactly two separate cards: My XP (orange, 'PLAY POINTS' badge, '{N} XP') and My Wallet (blue, 'FROM PARENT' badge, '₹{N}'), with no combined rupee-labeled total anywhere on the page. Move Money dialog for Grade 1 still correctly offers 🌱 My Garden as a transfer From/To option, so the underlying investing account is preserved. Dashboard 'My Garden' nav card for Grade 1 still navigates to /garden. No console errors, no regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y warning: DialogContent missing `Description`/`aria-describedby` on the Move Money dialog (React console warning). Pre-existing, not caused by this fix, but easy win.

Note for main agent: for Grade 4 (classmate_g4_qa), the Move Money transfer dropdown does NOT include the Stocks/investing account — only 3 options (My XP, Giving, My Wallet). This is expected: getFilteredAccounts() intentionally filters out `investing` for Kindergarten and Grade 3+ while Stocks feature is hidden (existing feature-flag behavior, unrelated to this fix). Grade 1 correctly retains 🌱 My Garden in the dropdown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WalletPage.jsx bug (yellow banner + My Garden XP-jar mislabeled as ₹) is fully fixed. Verified: (1) no [data-testid=total-balance] element in DOM; (2) no [data-testid=jar-investing]; (3) money-jars-grid children exactly ['jar-savings','jar-gifting'] for both G1 and G4; (4) no 'My Garden' / 'Stocks' / 'Money You Can Spend' text on /wallet; (5) top shows My XP (30 XP for g1, 0 XP for g4) + My Wallet (₹0) as separate cards; (6) Move Money dialog for g1 still lists '🌱 My Garden (0 XP)' as an option; (7) Dashboard My Garden card still links to /garden. Screenshots captured for both users.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification round for an already-applied fix. Root cause per E1: WalletPage.jsx was summing my_wallet + spending(XP) + savings + investing(XP) balances into a single `totalAvailable` variable displayed with a ₹ prefix, and rendering the investing (XP-denominated) account as a jar card alongside real-₹ jars. Fix removed the totals banner + dead computation entirely, and added `account_type !== 'investing'` filter to getJarAccounts(); getFilteredAccounts() (used by transfer dialog) untouched, preserving transfer functionality.
